# hex-scaffold

> CLI and library that generates a hexagonal Python module (domain, port, application service, in-memory adapter, tests) as byte-stable, importable Python. Python package `trysac-hex-scaffold`, import name `hex_scaffold`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
